placement: AB205 bend at header-top/principal-side butt; long leg vertical, short leg horizontal; trial hole row Y
disposition: With the long AB205 leg vertical, the old clip Y misses a reversible 4D loaded-edge screen and moving the row gives only a 0.148-mm nominal common 4D Y band. Swapping the legs widens that conditional band to 9.774 mm but puts the nearest principal hole much closer to its oblique-cut end; its along-grain ray is only 26.940 mm. Neither ray is a classified NDS end distance. Neither orientation is a buildable or rated joint on present evidence; further positions, load directions, tolerance and access checks remain open.

alternate_short_vertical.placement: AB205 bend at header-top/principal-side butt; short leg vertical, long leg horizontal; trial hole row Y

retained_axis_conflict_screen.limitations: Nominal centerline bore/occupied-axis screen only; not washers, plates, tools, tolerances, adjacent replacement connectors, or bolt capacity.

short_vertical_midband_trial.status: conditional_geometry_screen_only; no connector or drilling release

opposed_center_post_trial.proposal: one top and one underside AB205, each short leg vertical; two common through-header axes on matching horizontal long legs
opposed_center_post_trial.nominal_angle_envelope_source: ABB AB205 4-1/8 in height, 3-1/2 in base, 1-5/8 in width, 1/4 in thickness; ideal square-corner boxes, no bend radius or tolerances

source_rules.end_distance_definition: 2024 AWC NDS 12.1.2.2, printed page 81, defines bolt end distance parallel to grain from a square-cut timber end; it does not specify a direct measurement rule for this principal's oblique end.
source_rules.end_distance: 2024 AWC NDS 12.5.1.2 and Table 12.5.1A, printed page 98: softwood parallel-to-grain tension 3.5D minimum for C_delta=0.5 and 7D for C_delta=1.0
source_rules.edge_distance: 2024 AWC NDS 12.5.1.3 and Table 12.5.1C, printed page 99: 4D loaded edge for perpendicular-to-grain action
source_rules.oblique_end_limit: NDS 12.5.1.2(b) addresses angled loading/member connection shear area, not an oblique end-cut measurement. NDS 13.3.1.2 gives a sloping-end rule for split-ring/shear-plate connectors, not bolts. A bolt detail here needs an explicit designer interpretation and local tear-out/splitting check.

explicit_limits: The four 9/16-inch nominal bore cylinders pass through full raw timber thickness at the old clip line; this does not establish end/edge spacing, washer seats, other connector collisions or a feasible joint.
Both 4D Y intervals assume either side edge can become loaded in perpendicular-to-grain action and treat hole centers nominally. They are not tolerances or shop-drilling allowances.
The center principal is inclined. Its grain-parallel edge lines come from the actual CAD broad-side face, not the axis-aligned bounding box.
The 2024 NDS square-cut end-distance table must not be applied directly to the principal's oblique end; the along-grain ray is a diagnostic, not a design end-distance decision.
ABB publishes nominal AB205 family dimensions but no product-specific positional tolerance or guaranteed steel grade; no physical part was measured.
The new candidate's simultaneous joint actions, steel/wood resistance, backing, tool and withdrawal corridors, adjacent new structural connectors, and mirror station are not checked.
